adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which swallows the exception, does not log `err`, and uses `console.log` rather than an application logger. This is a concrete observability/monitoring issue introduced by the diff, though not necessarily a functional defect since the handler intentionally continues after email failure.
